title: Diode Laser Hair Removal in Dubai
h1: Diode laser hair removal: how it works and who it suits
desc: Diode laser hair removal explained: wavelength, why it suits coarse dark hair and many skin types, comfort, sessions and results at Skin & Laser Dubai.
answer: Diode lasers emit light at around 800 nm, which hair melanin absorbs well while reaching deep into the follicle. That makes diode very effective for coarse, dark hair on the legs, bikini, underarms, back and beard line, and with longer pulses and cooling it suits a wide range of skin tones.
facts: Light to dark, with adjusted settings
body:
## Why diode works well

The diode wavelength balances strong absorption by hair pigment with deep penetration, so it reaches the root of thick hairs. Contact cooling protects the skin surface and keeps sessions comfortable.

## Who it suits

Diode is a go-to choice for coarse hair and for men's back, chest and beard line. It also suits many olive and brown skin tones with longer pulses. For very light or fine hair, results are slower because there is less pigment to target.
